Subject: Post-call: Security & compliance discovery — SOC 2 / vendor questionnaire / roadmap

Hi Alice / Bob — great to connect earlier today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps: 

- Current SOC 2 posture: you mentioned SOC 2 Type I in 2024 and that Type II is in progress (thanks). Please confirm target date for Type II completion.
- Regulatory constraints: FinCo spans GDPR and some HIPAA-adjacent workloads — you flagged the need for data residency options and encryption-at-rest key management (KMS/HSM).
- Vendor questionnaire: you offered to start the vendor security questionnaire. I attached the FinCo questionnaire you shared during the call (FinCo_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx) and included our Redwood vendor questionnaire (see attachment).
- Immediate asks from our side: 
  1) A redacted copy of the latest SOC 2 attestation or bridge letter (if available).
  2) Primary security contact for follow-up (is that you, Alice?).
  3) Any special contractual requirements (data retention, audit rights, encryption keys).

Proposed mutual action plan:
- 1 week: Exchange vendor questionnaire + follow-up Qs (we can work in parallel).
- 2-3 weeks: Draft initial mutual action plan and determine SOC scope for Redwood (prod vs non-prod).
- 4-8 weeks: Evaluate requirements for scope expansion (ISO 27001 interest flagged on call), and identify path for any required certs (e.g., ISO / SOC scope / FedRAMP if needed long-term).

Next steps / ask: can you confirm who on your side will own the questionnaire and what timeframe works for returning it? Also let us know if procurement wants us to route any items to procureteam@fincollab.com.

Attachments: FinCo_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (from FinCo - included here for easy reference)

Thanks — happy to jump back on a short call to walk through the questionnaire once you've had a chance to start it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0123

Marissa / Rishi — quick internal notes on next steps and redlines to watch for when procurement returns a questionnaire: 

- SOC scope: If FinCo intends to put production customer data on Redwood, we'll want SOC 2 Type II coverage or a clear compensating control plan until Type II is complete. Consider proposing scoped pilot (non-prod / pseudonymized data) if they need faster time-to-value.
- BAAs / HIPAA: If PHI is in scope we'll need to route to legal for a BAA and validate our hosting model (customer-managed KMS is preferred).
- ISO 27001 / FedRAMP: FinCo mentioned ISO interest; escalate as a roadmap item. FedRAMP is an enterprise-level commitment — only pursue if there's clear spend/mandate. We should map the ask to a timeline and provide our recommended sequence: SOC 2 Type II -> ISO 27001 -> targeted FedRAMP readiness assessment.
- Questionnaire tips: mark any items that are "in progress" and provide expected dates. We should offer to fill out our side of any reciprocal questionnaire to speed review.

I'll draft a short guidance note we can send back along with Redwood_Vendor_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx.

-Lauren
